data.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-architectural-probe-gate.sh before the gate exists (RED). Tests: class:architectural triggers probe, class:behavioral does not, probe with empty output causes gate refusal.

## Test Cases
1. Epic classified class:architectural -> probe dispatch attempted -> exits 0 when probe produces non-empty output file
2. Epic classified class:behavioral -> probe NOT dispatched -> exits 0 directly (no-op)
3. Epic classified class:architectural -> probe produces empty output -> gate exits 1 (refusal)
4. Epic classified class:architectural -> probe exits non-zero -> gate exits 1 (refusal)

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-architectural-probe-gate.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-architectural-probe-gate.sh

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S4 classify-epic-class.sh for class signal)
data.title: T1: RED — Write test for architectural-probe dispatch gate
